<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Kinzaruk](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2646)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

In its natural state, the kinzaruk resembles a paper-thin, perfectly square sheet of lightweight silvery-white metal, approximately 15 feet across. It's almost never encountered this form, however, being far better known for its ability to intricately fold its body thousands of times in an instant to reconfigure itself into a varied assortment of deadly animal-like shapes.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 18

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 16

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 3">[Kinzaruk](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2646)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Elemental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=57" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 154

**Perception** +9; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Talican](/Languages.aspx?ID=112)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +11, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +9, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +7

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +3

**Dex** +4

**Con** +1

**Int** -4

**Wis** +0

**Cha** +0
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 19 

**Fort** +8 

**Ref** +11 

**Will** +7 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 45

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145)

**Resistances**
[electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56) 5

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** fly 10 feet (can't ascend more than 5 feet off the ground)

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
razor's edge +11 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d10+3 slashing

**Fold Form** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) The kinzaruk swiftly unfolds and refolds its body into a new shape chosen from the options of [_animal form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=10). This grants it the movement Speeds and Strikes of the chosen form, but none of the other benefits. Its attack bonus is unchanged, and its damage bonus is +3. The kinzaruk can return to its natural form by taking this action again, and automatically returns if it falls [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38).

</column>
